scientific_limitations: Deterministic homogeneous single population; exact simultaneous epidemic and opinion criticality.
Requires strictly negative initial opinion and weak peer pressure; no claim for positive initial opinion or heterogeneous networks.
Asymptotic results are in physical model time; not finite-population stochastic extinction probabilities.
Relevant network actSIS full text was inaccessible; priority comparison is not exhaustive.
title: Critical risk-averse opinion turns SIS extinction into a stretched exponential
